This role works differently from most product jobs, and the difference matters more than anything else on this page.
Ali, our founder and CEO, sets company priorities. You own the ideas. - If you’re looking for inbound or warm leads

This role is ideal if you want to learn outbound sales properly, build real commercial skills, and progress over time into broader Used and New Car Advertising roles.

title: Dispatcher / Dispečer
description:
Rohlik Group dynamicky roste po celé Evropě a doručuje čerstvé potraviny a nákupy milionům zákazníků napříč pěti mezinárodními trhy (CZ, AT, DE, HU, RO). Za naším rychlým, přesným a spolehlivým doručováním v rámci last-mile logistiky stojí propracovaný logistický systém, kde rozhoduje čas, práce s daty a rychlost operativy.

Jako Dispečer budeš mít pod palcem centrální řízení našich mezinárodních operací. Z našeho centralizovaného zázemí nebudeš jen sledovat trasy na monitoru - budeš aktivně koordinovat kurýrní provoz v reálném čase, řídit kapacitu doručovacích oken (slotů), vyrovnávat poptávku a dělat rychlá rozhodnutí během provozních špiček a nečekaných situací. Baví tě dynamické prostředí, kde díky tvému logickému uvažování a rychlým reakcím všechno šlape jako hodinky? Tady bude mít tvoje práce přímý dopad na spokojenost zákazníků i efektivitu celého provozu.

PROČ JE TAHLE ROLE ZAJÍMAVÁ

- Řídící centrum s mezinárodním přesahem: Budeš mít přímý dohled nad operativou a koordinací kurýrů napříč všemi našimi trhy (Česko, Rakousko, Německo, Maďarsko a Rumunsko).

- Přímý vliv na klíčové ukazatele: Tvoje rozhodnutí během směny přímo ovlivní dostupnost doručovacích časů, snížení zpoždění i optimalizaci vytížení kurýrů.

- Řešení výzev v reálném čase: Budeš klíčovou osobou při zvládání krizových situací, kapacitních omezení nebo nečekaných výpadků napříč regiony.

- Propojení s více týmy: Budeš úzce spolupracovat s vedením lokálních skladů, mezinárodní zákaznickou podporou i lídry dopravců (DSP).

- Prostor pro inovace: Rohlík se neustále posouvá dopředu - tvé nápady pomohou dále vylepšovat nástroje, procesy a model centrálního dispečinku.

CO TĚ U NÁS ČEKÁ

- Operativní řízení a monitoring: Sledování a koordinace denního provozu kurýrů na svěřených mezinárodních trzích s cílem zajistit hladký průběh doručování.

- Prioritizace a krizové řízení: Stanovování priorit při kapacitních omezeních, nepříznivém počasí nebo provozních odchylkách napříč regiony.

- Spolupráce napříč trhy: Koordinace kroků s týmy lokálních distribučních center, lídry DSP a zákaznickou péčí pro okamžité řešení vzniklých překážek.

- Plnění klíčových KPIs: Aktivní práce na maximalizaci dostupnosti doručovacích slotů, minimalizaci prostojů kurýrů a eliminaci zpoždění.

- Zpětná vazba pro plánování: Předávání poznatků z reálného provozu plánovacím týmům pro další zefektivnění trasování a lokální logistiky.

- Dodržování procesů a eskalace: Dohled nad dodržováním provozních standardů, přijímání nápravných opatření a včasná eskalace systémových problémů vedení.

CO OD TEBE OČEKÁVÁME

- Komunikační znalost angličtiny: Schopnost efektivně komunikovat v angličtině se zaměřením na psaný projev (např. přes Slack).

- Ochota pracovat ve směnách: Flexibilita pro 12hodinový provoz (krátký/dlouhý týden, ranní, celodenní a odpolední směny).

- Analytické a logické myšlení: Schopnost rychle zpracovávat větší množství dat v reálném čase z více zemí a dělat jasná, logická rozhodnutí pod tlakem.

- Odolnost vůči stresu a multitasking: Schopnost zachovat chladnou hlavu při řešení provozních výzev a efektivně prioritizovat úkoly.

- Férový a konstruktivní přístup: Umění řešit provozní či mezilidské nejasnosti objektivně a udržovat profesionální vztahy napříč mezinárodními týmy.

- Energii a chuť se učit: Pohotové reakce, flexibilitu a ochotu rychle si osvojovat nové postupy v dynamickém logistickém prostředí.

- Zkušenost výhodou: Předchozí praxe v oblasti dispečinku, logistiky, skladového provozu nebo zákaznické podpory je velkým plusem.

CO TI MŮŽEME NABÍDNOUT

- Hybridní model fungování: Po zaškolení možnost využívat Home Office (v závislosti na provozních potřebách dispečinku).

- Rohlík Xtra účet zdarma: Nakupuj s 10% cashbackem v podobě kreditů na další nákupy.

- Čas na odpočinek: Možnost placeného volna, když si potřebuješ vydechnout nebo zařídit osobní věci.

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
TALENT ACQUISITION SPECIALIST SNAPSHOT

Curvion Blue is looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist who knows how to find, assess, and attract high-performing sales talent.

This isn't a traditional HR recruiting role where you're posting jobs, waiting for applications, and hoping the right person wanders into the funnel.

You're going to be responsible for building and managing talent pipelines for sales roles across our business, with a heavy focus on identifying A-Players who can perform in high-ticket sales environments.

The ideal candidate has experience in Talent Acquisition or recruiting and understands how to source, qualify, interview, and move candidates through a high-volume hiring process.

Bonus points if you've actually sold before. Extra bonus points if you've sold high-ticket.

We want someone who understands salespeople because they've been one, worked closely with them, or recruited them extensively.

POSITION OVERVIEW

As a Talent Acquisition Specialist, you will own recruiting across Curvion Blue's sales organization and help us continuously build a bench of exceptional talent.

You'll work closely with leadership to understand what "great" looks like for each role, then take that profile into the market and find the people who match it.

This is a hands-on recruiting role for someone who enjoys sourcing, talking to candidates, assessing talent, and moving quickly.

You will be responsible for the full recruiting lifecycle, including sourcing, candidate outreach, screening, interview coordination, candidate evaluation, pipeline management, and offer management.

More importantly, you'll become an expert in identifying the difference between someone who sounds like a great salesperson and someone who can actually perform.

YOUR CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

Talent Sourcing

- Build proactive talent pipelines for closers, setters, sales leaders, and other revenue-generating roles.

- Source candidates through LinkedIn, job boards, referrals, communities, databases, and creative outbound strategies.

- Develop targeted sourcing strategies based on role requirements and candidate profiles.

- Continuously build talent pools rather than starting from zero every time a role opens.

Candidate Qualification

- Conduct recruiter screens to evaluate experience, communication, motivation, sales ability, and overall fit.

- Identify candidates with demonstrated performance rather than relying solely on resume keywords.

- Assess candidates against defined scorecards and role-specific success profiles.

- Understand sales metrics, quotas, KPIs, close rates, lead flow, revenue, and other performance indicators.

- Identify red flags and know when to move a candidate forward versus cut them from the process.

Sales Talent Acquisition

- Become deeply familiar with high-ticket sales roles and the characteristics of top-performing setters, closers, sales directors, and sales leaders.

- Understand the difference between legitimate sales experience and resume fluff.

- Build relationships with high-performing sales professionals and maintain a warm talent network.

- Help Curvion Blue become known as a destination for high-performing sales talent.

Candidate Experience

- Own candidate communication throughout the recruiting process.

- Keep candidates engaged, informed, and moving through each stage.

- Represent Curvion Blue professionally and enthusiastically.

- Create a candidate experience that reflects the level of talent we want to attract.

Recruiting Operations

- Maintain accurate candidate data and pipeline stages in our ATS.

- Track recruiting metrics including pipeline volume, conversion rates, time-to-fill, source performance, and quality of hire.

- Coordinate interviews, skills assessments, roleplays, and other evaluation stages.

- Partner with hiring managers to continuously improve the recruiting process.

- Identify bottlenecks and recommend ways to improve recruiting efficiency.

Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.
As an Inside Sales Account Executive, you will be part of a team that is transforming the way restaurants operate. Using a consultative approach, you will prospect, build relationships, and sign up new restaurateurs in your assigned territory. By understanding their unique needs, you will develop a customized solution that helps their business thrive. We need your passion and expertise to help us build the Toast brand in your geographic territory.
This is a remote sales opportunity based out of a personal home office.
A day in the life (Responsibilities)

• Generate list of prospective restaurants and manage the entire sales cycle from initial call to close

• Conduct demos and develop a solution that best meets the prospect’s needs

• Partner with teams across the business to ensure that expectations set during the sales process are met in delivery

• Leverage Salesforce (our CRM) to manage all sales activities

• Understand the competitive landscape and determine how to best position Toast in the market

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

• 1+ years of experience in a sourcing or closing sales role, restaurant operations, or a relatable field and industry

• Strong communication, organizational and presentation skills with the ability to sell and negotiate at all decision-making levels

• Proven track record of success in meeting and exceeding goals

• Ability to work in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial and team environment

• Self-motivated, creative, and flexible

• General technical proficiency with software

What will help you stand out (Nice to Haves/Nonessential Skills)

• Experience with Salesforce CRM

• Sandler Sales Training

The people who thrive here are those who embrace changes that let us build more for our customers; it’s a core part of our culture.

title: Java Software Engineer - Remote
description:
Company Overview

iboss is a could delivered Zero Trust network security platform trusted by more than 4,000 enterprises worldwide, including a significant number of Fortune 50 companies and U.S. government agencies. iboss enables the modern workforce to connect securely and directly to all applications from wherever they work. Built on a containerized cloud architecture, iboss delivers security capabilities such as SWG, malware defense, RBI, CASB, and data loss prevention to all connections via the cloud, instantaneously and at scale. This eliminates the need for traditional network security appliances such as VPNs, firewalls, and web gateway proxies, which are ineffective at protecting a cloud-first and mobile world. Leveraging a purpose-built cloud architecture backed by 230+ issued and pending patents and more than 100 points of presence globally, iboss processes over 150 billion transactions daily, blocking 4 billion threats per day. To learn more, visit www. iboss .com.
Job Description
As a Software Engineer at iboss , you’ll have the opportunity to work on multiple technologies. Our development scope extends from device specific driver, service, and communication protocols to cloud scalable connectivity and big data processing through third-party analytics tool integration and customer enterprise UI creation for security policy management. The pace is fast. The process is agile.
This is an excellent opportunity to become a core member of a rapidly growing software development team. There are many exciting projects on which to work. iboss software developers excel at solving tough problems, collaborating well, and working with customer teams to rapidly deploy solutions.
Responsibilities

• Ability to design and develop clean and maintainable code

• Quickly understand and extend engineering architectural patterns

• Document engineering designs

• Analyze and estimate development efforts

• Deliver high quality code that has been thoroughly tested

Qualifications

• 1 year of experience using Java technology stack and servlet containers

• 1 year of experience with frontend technologies (Javascript, HTML, CSS)

• Working knowledge of database technologies and SQL, especially PostgreSQL

• Experience with OO design and design patterns

• Comfortable working on a Unix environment

• Experience working in an Agile environment

• Team player with excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to work in a fast-paced environment

• Demonstrate excellent oral and written communication skills with the ability to listen, articulate, facilitate and advocate

Preferred Skills

• Experience with Tomcat and Spring

• Experience with single-page applications using frameworks such as AngularJS

• Knowledge of security, networking and handling of large datasets

• Ability to identify and resolve performance problems in code

• Experience building RESTful JSON APIs

Benefits

• Comprehensive health, dental, and vision benefits

• 401K with company match

• Unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO)

• Company paid holidays

The duties and responsibilities described above are essential functions of the job.

title: Sales Development Representative - B2B
description:
About Huzzle

At Huzzle , we connect exceptional talent with top opportunities at leading companies across the UK, US, Canada, Europe, and Australia. Our clients include fast-growing startups and established businesses in SaaS, MarTech, FinTech, and EdTech.
Unlike traditional outsourcing, you’ll be placed directly with a client as a core member of their team-giving you real ownership, career progression, and long-term stability.
Role Type: Full-time
Engagement: Independent Contractor
Job Summary
We are looking for a high-energy, results-driven Sales Development Representative to join a fast-paced B2B sales engine. In this role, you will be the frontline of our growth strategy, responsible for sparking interest and creating opportunities with key stakeholders. This is a high-volume, high-impact position designed for a hunter who thrives on the phones, excels at overcoming objections, and is eager to accelerate their career in professional sales.
Key Responsibilities

• Execute high-volume outbound prospecting campaigns, maintaining a daily output of 80 to 100 cold calls.

• Research and identify key decision-makers within target accounts to build a robust sales pipeline.

• Qualify leads through rigorous discovery to ensure alignment with our core solutions.

• Overcome gatekeepers and navigate complex B2B organizational structures to secure meetings for Account Executives.

• Meticulously track all activity and lead status within the CRM to ensure data integrity and seamless handoffs.

Requirements

• 2+ years of proven experience in a B2B Sales Development Representative (SDR) or Business Development Representative (BDR) role.

• Proven track record of managing high-volume cold calling requirements (80-100 calls per day).

• Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with the ability to build rapport quickly.

• Resilience and a "hunter" mentality; you view rejection as a step toward the next "yes."

• Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage a high-velocity workflow.

Nice-to-Haves

• Experience using advanced sales tech stacks (e.g., Salesforce, Outreach, Salesloft, or ZoomInfo).

• Prior experience in specialized B2B sectors or SaaS environments.

• A history of exceeding monthly or quarterly meeting-set quotas.

Benefits
🌎 Fully remote role with flexible working hours
🚀 Work with high-growth international companies
📈 Clear career progression to Account Executive and beyond
🎯 Performance-based bonuses and incentives
🤝 Direct hire with global clients (not outsourced)
🧠 Ongoing training, mentorship, and sales development support
